# 2 Baruch Chapter 87 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Baruch's Letters

---

**1** And it came to pass, when the eagle had been sent out and had flown away, that I, Baruch, went to the oak tree of Mamre, beneath which Abraham, our father, once prayed to the Lord when he was visited by his angels; and I, Baruch, remained there.

---

*LOGOS notes: Formal equivalence rendering from the Syriac (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1). Paragraph divisions follow the sense units of the source.*
